items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: As well as he and I got along, you know

ctx.x: I'm on the bandstand the next night, Max Gordon walks

in. I say oh-oh, he's going to bring me the bill. As well as he and I got along, you know, I say he's going to bring me the bill. He sit there until I got off the bandstand. Called me over. I sit down beside him. As soon as I sit down beside him, he threw his arms around my shoulder, (laughter) and shooked my hand and thanked me for tearing up the club and kicking his brother-in-law. That's the part that got it. Otherwise, I'd of had to pay for everything in there. If I hadn't of done something to his…

So he stayed there all night buying me drinks. And he's just laughing all night long. He say I can just see him on one side going across the room. (Laughter). He said, 'did he get up in a hurry, John?' I say 'no, he didn't get up in a hurry.' He wanted to know what did he do after that? I say he went back into the kitchen. (Laughter). Oh, he just laughed all night long. Bought the band drinks. Oh, he was real happy.
